item.title: INET: Priced for a Network Nobody Has Paid For Yet
item.description: Initiating at SELL, target Rp175. Revenue rose twenty times on acquisitions, but the internet EBITDA the price assumes does not exist yet.

item.title: IHSG: Foreign Selling Persisted. The Rebound Failed.
item.description: The IHSG fell 3.09% as IDX recorded Rp3.16tn of foreign net selling. Official weekly sectors, index movers and BI JISDOR clarify the risk.

item.title: Macro: Dovish or Hawkish
item.description: This report began as a question with no settled answer. For most of 2026 the Federal Reserve sat still while the rupiah fell to the weakest level ever recorded, which is the opposite of what the textbook spillover story predicts. On 16 September the Fed finally moved, and on 23 September Bank Indonesia gave its answer. That pair of decisions is the first clean test of the argument set out here, so this version is written around it.

item.title: Sector: The Memory War
item.description: Memory has been one of the most cyclical corners of the chip industry for more than a decade. Oversupply and falling prices give way to shortages and price spikes, and then the whole thing repeats. Generative AI could break that pattern, or at least bend it. Every AI accelerator that ships needs HBM sitting right next to it, so memory demand is now tied directly to accelerator volumes.

item.title: Sector: The Power Behind AI
item.description: Indonesia’s data-centre boom is becoming an energy story. Where does the value accrue across power, grid, connectivity, industrial land and data centres?

item.title: ADRO: The Smelter Is the Whole Thesis
item.description: Initiating at BUY, fair value IDR 3,354. FY2025 was the trough on price alone; the 500 ktpa aluminium smelter is the re-rating case.
